source_citation: Alfurayj, Yee and Lutfi, Bystanders Unveiled, TENCON 2023, pp. 1012–1017; Alfurayj and Lutfi, Exploring Bystanders’ Roles, TENCON 2023, pp. 1018–1023
protocol: Each blank-delimited thread: positive if corpus thread label is 1 or 2; flag if any text in thread has toxic-bert toxicity >=0.5. No training or threshold tuning.
limitations: Exploratory cross-task aggregate: toxicity per message vs thread bullying label; class 0 is aggression, not normal conversation; public Twitter threads, not private Instagram; repeated responses and thread length affect max score; no author-independence or pretraining-overlap audit; no text or IDs exported; not phone inference.
